title: JustEnoughItems issue #4180: [Crash]: [1.21.1] Game Crash when rendering Create Spout category (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException)

text: [issue by jim139129] ### Steps to Reproduce the Crash 1. Install NeoForge 1.21.1 with JEI, Create, and Farmer's Delight. 2. Open the inventory to access JEI. 3. Look up the "Spout" block from Create and check its "Uses" (Right-click). 4. Navigate to the "Spout Filling" tab. 5. The first page of recipes renders correctly. 6. Click the arrow to navigate to the **2nd page** of recipes. 7. The game crashes immediately. I have isolated this to a minimal instance with only Create, JEI, and Farmer's Delight. Removing Farmer's Delight stops the crash. ### Mod Pack URL (Optional) _No response_ ### Mod Pack Version (Optional) _No response_ ### Extra Notes (Optional) The crash occurs at `com.simibubi.create.compat.jei.category.animations.AnimatedSpout.draw`. While I understand the root cause likely lies within Create (attempting to access an empty fluid list index) or a malformed recipe from Farmer's Delight, I am reporting it here in hopes that JEI could potentially catch this exception during the recipe rendering phase. Ideally, a single malformed recipe render should not crash the entire client, but rather display an error placeholder for that specific entry if possible. I have already reported this to Farmer's Delight as well. ### Crash Report https://gist.github.com/jim139129/53125d5f5e81ccbe594a3de187b4acab [comment by mezz (owner)] Thanks for the report! I pushed some fixes that will allow JEI to catch this type of error and continue to run.
